description: Claim set for health-data backends (HIPAA-shaped expectations; this pack supports your conformity work — it confers no certification). Emphasis: minimum-necessary access, audit durability, retention/deletion discipline, secret hygiene.
authorYourself: Audit-log append-only: no actor (incl. operator) can rewrite history — requires storage-level control mapping.
Retention/deletion: expired records are cryptographically or physically erased on every replica/backup within the stated window — generation claims (INT-006) must be bound.
Break-glass access: emergency elevation is possible, alarmed, and retrospectively reviewable — step-up claims (AUTHZ-012) extended.
